feedback: This candidate shows a continuation of the previous iteration's approach, with the integral gain ki increased from 0.2 to 0.3 and the central sensor's y-position slightly raised from 0.05 to 0.055. Earlier races (iteration 4) demonstrated that reducing kd and softening sensor weights helped reduce oscillations and line loss on the oval track, but the s-bend track still caused off-track failures with 2 line loss events and higher steering oscillation (0.50 vs 0.34 on oval). The increase in ki aims to improve integral correction and reduce steady-state error, potentially aiding line tracking on bends. The sensor position adjustment may enhance line detection on curves. However, the base_speed remains at 1.35, which was previously insufficient to complete the s-bend track without line loss. Depending on the next race results, if stable control and no line loss are observed, consider increasing base_speed to 1.4 to improve pace. If line loss or oscillations persist, consider further tuning kd downward or adjusting sensor_weights to reduce sensitivity. Also, monitor steering_oscillation and control_effort closely to avoid excessive jitter or energy use.
requested_changes: controller.base_speed: 1.4 if no line loss next race (iteration 4 showed 1.35 insufficient)
controller.kd: try reducing below 1.2 if oscillations persist (iteration 4 showed lower kd helped)
controller.sensor_weights: consider softening weights further if line loss continues (iteration 4 evidence)
